notes: v2.9.48: mobile automatic-trading start/stop controls are rebuilt for immediate, one-tap operation. The start button is disabled while auto-trading is already running, the stop button is disabled while stopped, and both are locked while a command is pending so repeated taps cannot enqueue duplicate start/stop requests. The mobile card now shows 'starting/stopping' state immediately instead of waiting for the next one-second snapshot, polls command completion faster, and reports success/error inline instead of showing repeated confirmation/success popups. The PC command handler is idempotent for already-running/already-stopped requests. Most importantly, TradeEngine buy/full-sell/partial-sell submit paths now re-check engine.enabled immediately before broker submission, so pressing Stop prevents an already in-flight scan from creating a new automatic order after the stop request. Trading strategy and signal rules are unchanged.
